metadata.description: Widen the DeepSeek Harness Web UI conversation content area. The shipped chat column is 748px (--dsh-chat-content-width); this plugin overrides it — default 1200px, configurable — so messages, tables and the composer all render wider (Doubao-web-style). Pure CSS injection, no hos
